audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gives Lucian levels 2, 3, 4-5 and the 2+ item stage while the page's own prose says the exact opposite ('By level 2 your Q outranges his short kit and you take over', 'From level 2 onward the lane is yours', 'Lucian falls off hard against artillery'). The packet chart also gives Ziggs everything after level 1.
audit.why: Piercing Light is 500 range against Ziggs' 850 Q and Relentless Pursuit covers only 445 on a 16s base — Lucian owns level 1 and nothing after it in a lane he cannot close.
audit.corrected: Rows 1, 2 and 6 to Ziggs and row 3 to Skill, as one atomic group across both layers, with ratings. Rows 3 and 6 match the mirror's stated corrections exactly.

audit.whatIsWrong: No Lucian cooldowns anywhere; the stage whys were generic Ziggs boilerplate.
audit.why: Relentless Pursuit 16s at rank 1, Piercing Light 9s at rank 1 and The Culling 110s at rank 1 are the windows that decide when Ziggs may hold ground.
audit.corrected: Written into phases[1..3].why, phases[6].why, breakdown.cooldowns and report[5].

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing on the page states that Lightslinger turns his next attack into a double-shot after every ability, or that Lightslinger hits reduce Relentless Pursuit's cooldown — so 'step up on its downtime' is advice against a timer that is not fixed.
audit.why: A Ziggs counting 16 seconds will be caught by a dash that came back in far less; the readable cue is his ability casts and double-shots, not a stopwatch.
audit.corrected: Stated the cooldown reduction in report[5] and breakdown.cooldowns, and the double-shot as the step-back tell in phases[3].why and dontsFull[0].d.

edits.before: W Satchel online — your disengage button. You can now take a greedy trade and blast yourself out of the answer.
edits.after: Piercing Light reaches only 500 against your 850 — from level 2 you tax every walk-up he makes for a last hit.

edits.before: Full kit: E minefield behind you makes you nearly unchaseable. Bounce Q off the wave so Lucian can't read the angle.
edits.after: Relentless Pursuit is 16s at rank 1 and covers only 445 — lay E on your own feet so his dash-in lands in the mines.

edits.before: Stack Manaflow and chip Lucian below 60% — that's the zone where R + jungle help executes. Track Relentless Pursuit before every step-up.
edits.after: Chip him below 60%, but every ability he casts turns his next attack into a double-shot — count his casts, not his autos, before stepping up.

edits.before: Shadowflame + Torch makes the full rotation lethal, but the map matters more — rotate R to sieges and skirmishes.
edits.after: Shadowflame plus Torch and a 5000-range R: you decide sieges off-screen while his 1400 ultimate needs him standing still.

edits.before: Track Lucian’s Relentless Pursuit: His dash — lock him down while it is on cooldown. Forward steps wait for its downtime.
edits.after: Relentless Pursuit is 16s at rank 1 and covers only 445, but Lightslinger hits shorten it — count his casts, not the clock.

edits.before: - Lucian Relentless Pursuit: matchup-defining — His dash — lock him down while it is on cooldown. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget W Satchel for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Lucian Relentless Pursuit: 16s at rank 1, but every Lightslinger double-shot cuts it — step up when he has no casts banked. - Piercing Light is 9s at rank 1 and reaches 500. - The Culling is 110s and immobile: Satchel out of it.

edits.before: That is Lucian’s rehearsed moment — don’t audition for it.
edits.after: Lightslinger's double-shot is the tell — back off on his cast.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 you chunk him on every short-range walk-up.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 hinge on whether his 16s dash catches you.

notes: The chart was contradicting the page's own prose in four rows — content whys and the early/mid/late text all described Ziggs owning levels 2 onward while win[]/phases[].side said Lucian. Rows 3 and 6 match the mirror's stated fixes; rows 1 and 2 were not named by the mirror, and I flipped them to agree with the packet chart and the surrounding prose. The missingInteractions file asks for anti-heal on Lightslinger, but Riot's own description says only that Lucian gains bonus damage WHEN healed or shielded by an ally — he does not heal himself — so I wrote no Grievous Wounds line and the derived heal flag looks like a tooltip misfire.
